run_whitening_pipeline: run the whitening computation pipeline for a MultiGrain model using a specified backbone and checkpoint
compute_whitening_matrix: compute the whitening matrix by extracting embeddings from images and applying PCA via get_whiten
init_model_whitening: initialize whitening layers in the MultiGrain model before computing embeddings on the dataset
integrate_whitening_into_model: integrate the computed mean and PCA matrix into the MultiGrain model and save the checkpoint
resume_checkpoint_for_whitening: resume a MultiGrain model from a saved checkpoint to compute whitening on a new image list
